design_rationale:
WORKLOG / DOSSIER — task 1 (order_item_refunds_fees_and_tips, category order). frozen_time 2026-09-21 14:30:00 CDT. (Revised in rework round 2.)

1. Draw (scripts/draw_counts.py --task 1): prerequisite_problems 3, factor_counts [6, 5, 4, 6]. Taken: photo-review claim 6, service-fee share 6, price protection 5, weight overage 4.

2. Why a good test. The customer asks only for money back for a spoiled sockeye salmon fillet (line 1, weighted, 41.80). The line is charged above the Stock-Up photo threshold 30.00 and no photo is on the case, so the agent cannot refund it: it becomes the customer's own photo-review claim (owner=user). The claim is not registered until any weight-overage refund owed on that line stands, and only after the service-fee share owed for the item refunds standing has been returned. The fee-share rule shares the service fee back only once a price-protection or weight-overage refund stands, and is fixed only after every such refund owed stands. From the records the agent must find: the salmon billed 2.46 lb against 2.00 lb requested (no weight_overage refund), the Cabot cheddar chosen by the shopper (auto_best_match) at 12.49 against 8.99 (above 8.99 x 1.25, no price-protection refund), and hence the fee share. Every write has exactly one tool.

3. Scope. Task 0 holds the wrong-item, unfound-line, over-cap and limit-review policies and tools. Claimed here: order_ext_substitution_price_protection, order_ext_weight_overage_refund, order_ext_service_fee_share_refund, order_ext_photo_review_claim_amount; tools refund_substitution_overcharge_0e292d66, refund_weight_overage_a9b70a98, refund_service_fee_share_1e350a8d, submit_photo_review_claim_a5aac31c (user). Together all 8 policies, disjoint.

4. Problem-tree card. Root PH (user). Edges, all value_input, state form:
 - PH -> WO (ph_line_refunded): "A photo-review claim on a line sold by weight is not registered until any weight-overage refund owed on that line stands on the order." False at opening: 1c6f1f3a quantity 2.46 vs requested 2.0, no weight_overage refund. Skip -> claim 57.72.
 - PH -> SF (ph_fee_returned): "A photo-review claim is registered only after the service-fee share owed for the item refunds already standing on the order has been returned as a fee refund." False: no order_fee_refunded entry. Skip -> 45.33.
 - SF -> WO (sf_wo_refunded): "The service-fee share refund is fixed only after the weight-overage refund owed on every line sold by weight and billed above its overage allowance stands on the order." Skip -> 3.02.
 - SF -> PP (sf_pp_refunded): "The service-fee share refund is fixed only after the price-protection refund owed on every unapproved replacement billed above its protected price stands on the order." False: 16161217 auto_best_match 12.49 vs 8.99. Skip -> 2.34.
 Each waited-on refund kind is booked by exactly one policy. PP and WO commute (replayed both orders: identical 17.40 / 10.61 / 4.07 / 43.99). Order PP, WO, SF, PH.

5. Base-invariant card. completed_order: 6d3cb85e completed. issue_window: day 0 = 2026-09-19, Stock-Up window 5 days -> last day 2026-09-24 inclusive; frozen 2026-09-21 inside; 2026-09-25 refused. once_per_line_reason: no refund on lines 1 and 2; 17.40 < 24.98, 10.61 < 41.80. Rolling limits: 1 issue refund (6.49) in 90 days; weight overage and price protection do not count. late_refund_quota: no late_delivery refund. Other base policies scope only.

6. Business-object card. Line 1 charge 1c6f1f3a (salmon 41.80) -> weight_overage refund and the claim. Line 2 charge 16161217 + decision b77f5f26 -> price protection. Service fee 159dd1e4 (7.52) + member waiver 66f62358 (3.77) -> fee share. Delivery fee f8195ccc (9.99) enters the uplift test only. Damaged refund 369723f5 (line 5, 6.49) is an existing issue refund.

7. Factor card (handling-time run). PP 17.40 (baseline 2.50): protected price = original (method; annual & 47 months >= 24; cap-raised price -> 7.50); guarantee x2 (3 fees < 36 months; x1 -> 9.70); uplift 10% (-> 16.00); standing allowance 1.00 (-> 16.40); handling 1.00 (-> 16.40). WO 10.61 (baseline 4.42): tolerance 0 (10 -> 6.43); price at original 18.99 (-> 9.60); uplift 10% (-> 9.74); allowance 1.00 (-> 9.61). SF 4.07 (baseline 0.32): basis every item refund 34.50 (issue only -> 1.29); pre-saving fee share (proportional -> 2.93); goodwill 20% (-> 3.50); uplift 10% (-> 3.76); days 0.50 (-> 3.57); tenure 0.15 (-> 3.92). PH 43.99 (baseline 31.19): line value at regular price 34.86 (-> 39.83); fee part at standing rate 1.04 (-> 42.85); goodwill 10% (-> 40.40); spoilage 2.00 for billed weight above requested (-> 41.99); order-issue 1.50 (-> 42.49); tenure 1.00 (-> 42.99). Cross-difficulty evidence: membership a8d33c9a (Cartwise+ Annual, enrolled 2022-09-20) and fee rows 2022-09-20 .. 2026-09-20. Near-misses (tier-deciding): completed_at is 2026-09-19T18:20 and frozen_time 2026-09-21 14:30, so 2 calendar days have passed from the date of completed_at while only 44 hours have elapsed — a reader counting elapsed 24-hour days takes the 1-day tiers of the price-protection and weight-overage standing allowances (0.50: PP 16.90, WO 10.11) and misses the 2-day tiers of the fee-share days credit and the photo spoilage credit; further, by the anniversary convention: tenure from 2022-09-20 to the placed date 2026-09-18 is 47 anniversary months — a calendar-month reader counts 48 and takes the >=48 tier (fee-share tenure 0.30 instead of 0.15, photo tenure 2.00 instead of 1.00); the 2025-09-20 fee is exactly 12 months old and the 2023-09-20 fee exactly 36 months old, both outside their windows.

8. Persona. Desmond Galloway, pharmacist, methodical; volunteers only the spoiled salmon and money back; gives phone 3125527309 and email desmond.galloway@inboxly.com when asked; asked about other items he only says he did not look closely at the rest of the order — the weight and the cheddar reach the agent only through the prerequisite sentences and the records; submits the claim only when handed over, with the agent's figures; ends when it shows submitted.

9. Standard solution. find_customers -> verify (phone+email) -> find_orders -> find_order_events(order) -> find_memberships -> find_membership_events -> find_order_review_requests -> PP 17.40 -> WO 10.61 -> SF 4.07 -> hand over PH 43.99.

10. Verification. Gates re-run after rework: check_extended, check_task_tools, replay_tasks, check_solvability, check_compute, check_grounding, check_cross_fire all OK.

11. Draft recomputation from the visible context gives the same four figures in the order the prerequisite sentences state.

12. Revisions. Round 1: fee-share method tier 1 re-based on the pre-saving fee. Round 2 (policy-task audit): T1-C1 persona no longer names the weight or the cheddar; T1-F1 / F-4 the guarantee is a parameter and the protection margin became the protected-price method (original / average of original and billed / cap-raised price); T1-F2 / F-5 spoilage credit re-laddered on billed vs requested weight; T1-F3 membership re-dated to 2022-09-20 with annual fees each 20 September, creating the tenure and window-boundary near-misses (SF 4.22 -> 4.07, PH 44.94 -> 43.99); E-1 anniversary convention stated in every month-window rule; X-1 fee-share scope narrowed (only after a price-protection or weight-overage refund); E-5 'deli' wording restored.

13. Rework round 3 (policy-task audit revision 2). T1-F3 residual: the order window moved to 16:00-19:00 and completed_at to 2026-09-19T18:20 (still on time, same date), so the calendar-day rule ("from the date of completed_at to today") gives 2 days while elapsed time is 44 hours — a tier-deciding near-miss for the price-protection (17.40 vs 16.90) and weight-overage (10.61 vs 10.11) standing allowances. All scored figures unchanged (17.40 / 10.61 / 4.07 / 43.99). Persona: delivery now 'Saturday evening'.
user_scenario:
You are Desmond Galloway, a hospital pharmacist in Chicago who does one big Whole Foods stock-up delivery on Cartwise most weekends. You are calm and methodical, a little dry, and you like to hear numbers spelled out. Your Stock-Up delivery came on Saturday evening, September 19, and when you opened the Wild Alaskan sockeye salmon fillet on Sunday evening to cook it, it smelled off and the flesh was slimy, so it went straight in the trash. You want your money back for that salmon; that is what you are calling about.
You give details only when the agent asks for them. Your mobile number is 3125527309 and your email is desmond.galloway@inboxly.com; if a third detail is needed, your date of birth is 1988-07-23 and your home ZIP code is 60640. The order is the Whole Foods Stock-Up delivery from Saturday, September 19. You did not photograph the fish before throwing it out, and you have nothing but what the app shows. If the agent asks where money back should go, back to your card is fine. If the agent asks about the other items on the order, you say you put everything away without looking closely and have nothing to report about the rest; you ask for nothing else.
You are fine with the agent looking through the order and putting right whatever the records call for; you do not know Cartwise's rules. If the agent tells you about other corrections on the order, you acknowledge them and thank them. If the agent explains that the salmon cannot be refunded on the spot without a photo and has to go to the review team as a claim you submit yourself, you accept that, and once the agent hands the claim over to you with the figures to enter, you submit it exactly as given and read back the reference and status you see. You never propose an amount of your own and you do not dispute the agent's figures. Once the salmon claim shows as submitted, you thank the agent and end the call.
